title: New Horizons Coins
description: Mod for New Horizons SMP, adding coins, and a Smith for exchange
body:
# NHCoins

NHCoins is a vanilla-friendly economy and currency mod for Minecraft, designed for multiplayer survival servers and SMPs.

The mod introduces a complete custom currency system with immersive progression, rare resource gathering, and a dedicated exchange workstation while keeping the visual style close to vanilla Minecraft.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🪙 Custom Currency System
Adds three fully custom currencies:

- Bronze Sickles
- Silver Ducats
- Gold Mohurs

Each coin features unique Minecraft-style textures and distinct value tiers for server economies, trading, shops, and progression systems.

---

### 🏦 Coin Smith Workstation
Exchange and break down currency using the custom Coin Smith block.

Features:
- Custom GUI and menu
- Recipe-driven conversion system
- Shift-click bulk conversion
- Vanilla-style inventory interaction
- Fast denomination breakdown

---

### 🌌 Voidcore Resource Progression
Adds a rare End-themed material progression system:

- Voidcore Ore
- Voidcore Fragments
- Voidcore Ingots

Players can mine rare resources, refine them into high-tier materials, and convert them into premium currency.

---

### 🎨 Vanilla-Friendly Design
NHCoins is built to blend naturally into Minecraft with:
- Pixel-perfect Minecraft-inspired textures
- Vanilla-style GUI design
- Lightweight mechanics
- SMP-focused gameplay balance

---

## 🎯 Designed For
NHCoins works especially well for:
- SMP servers
- Roleplay economies
- Player shops and markets
- Long-term progression systems
- Server events and rewards

---

## ⚙️ Environment
This mod must be installed on both the client and server.

---

## 🔮 Planned Features
Future updates may include:
- Banking systems
- Advanced economy mechanics
- Additional rare resources
- Expanded exchange systems
- Currency sinks and balancing

---

Craft. Exchange. Prosper.
